acceptance: Repository exists with the three-crate workspace, MIT licence and README stating scope and the no-fork rule.
CI runs cargo fmt --check, clippy -D warnings and tests on Linux and macOS.
A wheel build job produces installable cp311-abi3 wheels for every listed platform; a smoke test imports the module and streams one Arrow batch through the PyCapsule interface into pyarrow.
The library has no dependency on BenchBox Python code.
description:
First stage of the BenchBox-owned Rust data generation library (docs/internal/adr/adr-benchbox-datagen.md (revised 2026-11-26, PR #4540), decisions 1 and 3). Create BenchBox-dev/benchbox-datagen (MIT) with crates benchbox-datagen-core, benchbox-datagen-writers and benchbox-datagen-py, CI (fmt, clippy, tests) and cp311-abi3 wheel builds for macOS arm64/x86_64, Linux glibc and musl x86_64/aarch64 and Windows x86_64.

Decision gate: creating a repository in the BenchBox-dev organisation may need owner permissions; if gh repo create is refused, stop and ask the owner to create it. Publishing to PyPI is a release action and needs owner approval.

Guardrails: no fork of tpcgen-rs; no auto backend mode or silent fallback; Python stays the only manifest writer; heavy measurements only through make heavy-run with N=3 medians recorded in the PR body; budgets from the ADR table are the gate, and a miss goes to the owner rather than being waived.
